description: This file defines a composable UI component AppListItem, which displays app information such as icon, name, package name, and toggle switches for hiding and locking the app, as well as an icon button to launch the app. It is used within an Android project utilizing Jetpack Compose for UI.

methods.name: AppListItem
methods.description: A composable function that creates a list item UI for displaying app info with toggle switches for hide and lock, and an icon button to launch the app.
